name: adapt_memory_limit_yaml_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: memory_limit.txt (a spec file the Deployment container's memory limit must match) is REWRITTEN between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger); the agent must re-read it and update the limit, not leave the stale value in place
prompts: Write a Kubernetes Deployment manifest at deployment.yaml for a Deployment named api, one container named api using image myorg/api:latest, with resources.limits.memory set to EXACTLY the value in memory_limit.txt (currently 256Mi).
memory_limit.txt has changed. Update deployment.yaml's memory limit to match the CURRENT value in the file.

disruptions.description: memory_limit.txt rewritten to a higher limit

test_setup_files.test_deployment.py:
import yaml

with open('memory_limit.txt', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    current = f.read().strip()

with open('deployment.yaml') as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f)

containers = data['spec']['template']['spec']['containers']
api = next(c for c in containers if c.get('name') == 'api')
got = api.get('resources', {}).get('limits', {}).get('memory')
assert got == current, f'memory limit is {got!r}, want the CURRENT memory_limit.txt value {current!r} (stale limit not updated)'
print('PASS')

reference_solution.deployment.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: api
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: myorg/api:latest
          resources:
            limits:
              memory: 512Mi
